data.comment: MT — gender-invariant: no participle and no personal noun, so nothing agrees with the character («Gracz od {0}» is no good, «gracz» being masculine). The colon puts {0} in a nominative slot. Terminology matches NavCharactersRegistered («Zarejestrowano»).
